categories.editHint: Tap a category to edit it or set a monthly budget
categories.deleteUsed_one: This category has 1 transaction. It will be hidden, but the transaction is kept.
categories.deleteUsed_other: This category has {{count}} transactions. It will be hidden, but those transactions are kept.

kindHint.expense: Only money you spend can go in this category.
kindHint.income: Only money you receive can go in this category.
kindHint.both: Spending and income are both allowed and counted separately, e.g. a side business.

categories.kindInUse_one: This category has 1 “{{type}}” transaction. Keep it as Both, or move that transaction first.
categories.kindInUse_other: This category has {{count}} “{{type}}” transactions. Keep it as Both, or move those transactions first.

accounts.deleteUsed_one: This account and its 1 transaction will be permanently deleted.
accounts.deleteUsed_other: This account and its {{count}} transactions will be permanently deleted.
accounts.deleteTransfers_one: 1 of them is a transfer with another account, so that account's balance will change too. Archive instead to keep everything as it is.
accounts.deleteTransfers_other: {{count}} of them are transfers with other accounts, so those balances will change too. Archive instead to keep everything as it is.
accounts.currencyChangeMessage_one: 1 transaction on this account is in {{list}}. It keeps that currency, so its money will show as a separate {{list}} line on the account.
accounts.currencyChangeMessage_other: {{count}} transactions on this account are in {{list}}. They keep that currency, so their money will show as a separate {{list}} line on the account.
accounts.missingRates: Not counted: {{list}}. Set exchange rates in Settings.

groupHint.regular: Everyday money. Shown in the balance at the top by default.
groupHint.savings: Money set aside. Listed separately and only counted when you pick it in the accounts filter.
groupHint.debt: A person or loan. Positive balance: they owe you. Negative balance: you owe them.

transactions.empty: No transactions in this period. Tap + to add one.
transactions.skipped_one: 1 transaction wasn't changed because the change doesn't fit it
transactions.skipped_other: {{count}} transactions weren't changed because the change doesn't fit them

editor.chooseOtherAccount: Choose a different account to transfer to
editor.name: Name

settings.currencyConfirmMessage: Totals and reports will be shown in {{currency}}.
settings.currencyConfirmConvert: Totals and reports will be shown in {{to}}. Exchange rates and budgets will be converted at 1 {{to}} = {{rate}} {{from}}.
settings.currencyMovesAccounts_one: Your unused {{from}} account will switch to {{to}}.
settings.currencyMovesAccounts_other: Your {{count}} unused {{from}} accounts will switch to {{to}}.
settings.currencyRateMessage: How much is 1 {{to}} in {{from}}? Your exchange rates and budgets will be converted with it.
settings.exportCsvHint: Open your transactions in Excel or Google Sheets
settings.backupHint: Save everything to a file you can restore later
settings.restoreHint: Replace current data with a backup file
settings.restoreMessage: Everything currently in Budgy will be replaced by the backup.
settings.restoreMessageSynced: Everything in Budgy will be replaced by the backup, on this device and in your account.
settings.invalidBackup: That isn't a Budgy backup file
settings.eraseMessage: All accounts, categories and transactions will be deleted. Make a backup first if you might need them.
settings.eraseMessageSynced: All accounts, categories and transactions will be deleted from this device and your account. Make a backup first if you might need them.
settings.about: Your data stays on this device
settings.aboutSynced: Your data is on this device and synced to your account
settings.ratesHint: Used to add up balances and reports in {{currency}}.

debts.empty: No debts yet. Add a debt account for each person or loan you want to keep track of.
debts.hint: To lend money, make a transfer from your account to the debt. When you get paid back, transfer from the debt to your account. Borrowing works the other way round.

finances.hint: Assets are all positive balances, debts all negative ones, across every account.

profile.name: Your name
profile.backupHint: Saves all your data to a file you can restore on any device.

dbError.title: Budgy couldn't open your data
dbError.message: Nothing was changed. This can happen when the phone is low on storage or the browser blocks storage (for example in private browsing). Close Budgy completely and open it again.

onboarding.currencyHint: Your accounts, totals and reports will use it. You can change it later in Settings.

reminder.never: Your data is only on this phone. Back it up so you don't lose it.
reminder.stale: Your last backup is more than a month old.

cloud.title: Account & sync
cloud.hint: Sign in to keep a copy of your data in your account, so you can get it back if you change phones or reinstall Budgy. Without an account, everything stays on this device.
cloud.error: Couldn't sync. Tap to try again.
cloud.signOutMessage: Your data stays in your account. Keep a copy on this device too?
cloud.deleteMessage: Your account and all the data stored in it will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
cloud.deleteKeepLocal: Delete, keep data on this device
cloud.signInFailed: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.
cloud.notSetUp: Sign-in with {{provider}} isn't set up yet.
cloud.offline: No connection. Try again when you're online.
cloud.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
cloud.mergeMessage: This device has data too. Merge both, or replace this device's data with the account's?

sms.title: Import from SMS
sms.permissionDenied: Budgy can't read texts. To allow it, open Android Settings → Apps → Budgy → Permissions → SMS.
sms.disclosureBody: Budgy reads texts only from the bank senders you list below, on this phone only. It keeps the amount, date, merchant and last digits of each one, never the full message, and nothing is sent anywhere.
sms.sendersHint: Only texts whose sender name contains one of these words are read.
